title: Daily report data

reasons.TIME_ZONE_NOT_PROVEN: Daily report boundaries have not been established for this source time zone.
reasons.OPEN_DAY: The selected day has not ended in the source time zone. Choose a completed day.
reasons.CAR_NOT_FOUND: The selected truck is not available in the connected Karma account.
reasons.UPSTREAM_FAILURE: Karma did not complete the request. Any available values describe only the loaded subset.
reasons.PAGE_LIMIT: The page limit was reached. These values describe only the loaded subset.
reasons.ROW_LIMIT: The row limit was reached. These values describe only the loaded subset.
reasons.INCOMPATIBLE_SOURCE: The returned source data could not be reconciled with this day's selection.
reasons.OPEN_TRIPS: The selection contains trips whose completion is not confirmed. Final daily distance and speed values are not available.
reasons.SOURCE_BOUNDARY_NOT_PROVEN: Additional trips remain outside the loaded selection. These values describe only the loaded subset.

emptyHint: The completed query returned no trips for this day. Zero distance is distinct from an unavailable value.
selectionHint: Trips belong to the source-local day when they started, including trips that ended after midnight. Unfinished trips prevent final distance and speed totals.
unitsHint: Distance and speed retain the raw source units. Their physical units have not been confirmed.
positionCoverageHint: Position sample coverage has not been assessed. A completed query does not prove that every physical trip or position was recorded.
tripCountFormula: Number of trips in the selected dataset.
nightDistanceFormula: Sum of source night distances, preserving Karma's night classification:
dayDistanceFormula: Total distance minus night distance. No odometer delta is added.
maxSpeedFormula: Maximum of the available source trip maxima:
missingHint: Missing source inputs are not counted as zero. The availability and input counts apply to each value separately.
dayHint: Choose a completed day in the truck's source time zone. Yesterday is selected by the server when no day is specified.
dayInvalid: Choose a valid completed calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD).
lastReportedHint: This is the latest message returned by Karma, independent of the selected historical report day. It is not guaranteed live.
historicalMapInDetails: The selected trip's historical endpoints are open in its details.
tripEndpoints: Historical trip endpoints from this report selection. They do not establish a recorded path.
tripUnavailable: This trip is not present in the loaded report selection. Choose an available row or another day.
compositionUnavailable: Day/night composition is unavailable until both values cover the same complete retrieved selection. Missing values are not zero.
compareInvalid: Choose a different valid calendar day (YYYY-MM-DD).
compareHint: Select another completed day for this truck in the same source time zone. Each day keeps its own retrieval time. Differences require complete, comparable values.
